key_facts: DISA posted a sources-sought notice on July 27 seeking industry feedback on the CommandNet migration after GDIT's protest.
The CommandNet effort aims to move approximately 231,000 users at 200 sites across all 11 combatant commands to DODNet by fiscal 2028.
DISA had planned a sole-source task order to Leidos under the $11.5 billion Defense Enclave Services contract, which GDIT protested to GAO on July 10.
The protest has since been dismissed following DISA's new call for market research.
GDIT argued DISA overstated Leidos' performance, noting Leidos migrated only ~40,000 of a required 370,000 Fourth Estate users under DES.
